correctness.rationale: For nonzero B the main formula is mathematically correct. Xu–Zhang–Liu Prop.2.2 yields ∂∂bar Fε(A+wB)≥(p²/4)(((a+b|w|)²+ε)^(p/2−1))||B||₂². In the scalar disk Green formula, (2/π) times the polar 2π times p²/4 gives p². ε↓0 is monotone for p≤2, and finite-dimensional Fε converges uniformly on the compact circle. For arbitrary H restrict A,B to the common separable reducing support generated by their compact ranges and adjoint ranges, then finite-rank compressions converge in S_p and S₂, and use ||A_N||op≤a, ||B_N||op≤b. For 0<p<2,B≠0, s<t implies (a+bs)^(p−2)>(a+bt)^(p−2), while ∫_0^t s log(t/s)ds=t²/4. At p=2 equality follows by Fourier orthogonality. For A=0 and rank-one B, p²∫_0^t s(bs)^(p−2)log(t/s)ds=t^p b^(p−2), so equality holds; independent numerical quadrature checked p=0.5,1,1.5,2 for rank-one b=2,t=1.3. HOWEVER the printed universal quantifier includes A=B=0. For each 0<p<2 the integrand is s(0)^(p−2)log(t/s), not locally finite on (0,t], while ||B||₂²=0; the product 0·∞ is undefined and the stated “if a=0 integrable” convention is not applicable when b=0. The submitted RHS therefore has no value in an expressly included case. A separate B=0 trivial case or exclusion is required. This is a boundary-definition defect rather than a counterexample with a reversed finite inequality; source unchanged because independent O and V also fail.

value.rationale: A scale-sensitive sharp integral could be useful as an exposition of the 2026 pointwise estimate: it is strictly larger than its outer-radius freeze for 0<p<2,B≠0 and equals the scalar rank-one circular defect at A=0. Nevertheless every part of the claimed gain is the elementary result of inserting an already-established radial curvature lower bound into the standard Green identity; rank-one sharpness is the standard ∫_0^1 u^(p−1)log(1/u)du=1/p². There is no additional unknown invariant, new lemma, nonstandard optimization or independent boundary phenomenon, and no demonstrated application requiring this exact display beyond the published local result. Under the common value bar this is a routine integration/repackaging of known stronger data rather than a distinct motivated mathematical contribution; the numeric improvement alone does not establish independent value.
